en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined path or avenue on the left leading into the distance, with birch trees casting shadows on the ground. On the right side are open fields and a river or stream, and beyond them a town with church towers and multi‑storey buildings, set against low hills or mountains. In the lower left border, there is cursive text identifying the location.
